manifest.name: dsh-typography
manifest.description: Typography plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: independent interface-font and code-font sections, online presets, and a local font library served from $DSH_HOME/typography (woff2/ttf/otf, no conversion needed)
manifest.author: Gan332

bundle.text:
# dsh-typography profile patch layer — insert one loader entry for this
# plugin package, exactly like the shipped ui-* rows. The entry id is the
# service name other code can ctx.get("typography"); the browser half is
# picked up by dsh-client-modules through the package's dsh.client
# declaration and served at /plugins/dsh-typography/client.js.
#
# `dir` points the host half's local font library at $DSH_HOME/typography —
# drop .woff2/.ttf/.otf files there and they become servable at
# /plugins/dsh-typography/files/<name> without any conversion.
- insert:
    - id: typography
      name: 'dsh-typography'
      config:
        dir: !!js dshHomePath('typography')

readme.text: <div align="center">

**DeepSeek Harness 的排版自定义插件** — 界面字体与代码字体独立切换 · 在线预设 · 本地字体库免转换 [](https://github.com/Gan332/dsh-typography/stargazers) [](https://github.com/Gan332/dsh-typography/issues) [](./LICENSE) [English](./README.en.md) | 中文
DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的字体入口是两个 CSS 变量：`--dsw-font-family`（界面）与 `--ds-font-family-code`（代码），全部组件经 `var()` 消费。dsh-typography 把它们变成两组**互相独立**的选择：

- **界面字体 / 代码字体分开管**：各自的预设卡片、导入编辑器与持久化状态，互不影响
- **在线预设**：Inter + JetBrains Mono、IBM Plex Sans + Fira Code、Noto Sans SC（简中全覆盖）；字体文件经 jsDelivr CDN 分发，离线自动回退系统字体栈
- **本地字体库**：把任意 `woff2/ttf/otf` 丢进 `%DSH_HOME%\typography\`，刷新后一键应用 —— **TTF 直接可用，无需转 woff2**
- **可变字体友好**：字重可选“可变·全字重”，生成 `font-weight: 100 900` 的 `@font-face`，粗细真实呈现
- **默认即放手**：某组选“默认”时不输出任何样式，可与其它字体类插件共存
- **跨 DSH 版本兼容**：适配 DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2——`defineStore` 引擎位于 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`，但该包不带 `dsh.client` 声明、不会进入客户端模块表，因此插件内置最小快照 store 引擎（动作签名与官方契约一致：`(draft, ...args) => void`）；`dsh.client.inject` 只声明各版本都提供的核心服务（slots / locale）

本插件为双面插件（host 半边分发本地字体文件，浏览器半边提供注册表与设置行），安装后出现在 **设置 → 通用 → 字体（界面 / 代码）**。

**安装方式：**

DeepSeek Harness 有两个入口，各自有独立的 profile —— 在哪边用就装进哪边：

```sh

readme.section: DSH Desktop 桌面应用（默认端口 43120）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Gan332/dsh-typography

readme.section: 命令行 dsh web（默认端口 3080）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add -w /path/to/dsh-typography

readme.section: 本地目录（profile 目录是 pnpm workspace 根，必须加 -w）
readme.text:
```

然后重启对应入口。桌面端注意：终端安装会记入一个恢复事务，**重启应用后自动验证并清理**；连续安装多个插件时需逐个重启。

**切换字体：** 每组点击卡片实时应用；“默认”恢复系统字体栈。powershell
copy C:\Users\fish\Downloads\MiSansVF.ttf $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\typography\
```

刷新页面 → 对应组 → 本地字体库 → 点击 `MiSansVF`。以“可变·全字重”接入，零转换。

**字体链接写法** —— 优先推荐同源相对路径（与端口无关）：
/plugins/dsh-typography/files/MiSansVF.ttf          ✅ 推荐（同源路径）
http://127.0.0.1:43120/plugins/dsh-typography/...   ⚠️ 可用，端口变化后失效
https://cdn.example.com/some-font.woff2             ✅ 外部 CDN 直链
```

浏览器半边在 `apply` 时把注册表挂到根上下文，其它插件可用 `ctx.get("typography")` 消费：

```ts
const typography = ctx.get("typography")
// 两组独立选择："ui" | "code"
typography?.select("code", "inter-jetbrains")
typography?.setCustom("ui", [

完整类型见 `lib/types/client/index.d.ts`。

- 浏览器半边 `apply` 时通过 `ctx.provide("typography", registry)` 挂出注册表；选择变更时重写注入的 `<style id="dsh-typography-style">`：`@font-face` 规则 + 仅覆盖非默认组的 CSS 变量
- host 半边通过 `ctx.webServer` 注册 `/plugins/dsh-typography/files/*` 路由，分发 `%DSH_HOME%\typography` 下的字体文件（按扩展名给出 `font/woff2 | font/ttf | font/otf`；`?list=1` 返回索引 JSON）
- 选择持久化在 `localStorage`（`dsh-typography:prefs`），启动时恢复；恢复时忽略已失效的预设 id
- 设置行经 `ctx.slots` 注册进 Settings → General 的 item 槽位（id `typography`），文案走 `ctx.locale` 双语字典

- 在线预设需要联网；离线时沿字体栈尾部回退系统字体
- 本地库文件名需以字母/数字开头（Unicode 字母即可，中文文件名可用）
- 少量组件硬编码了 `Inter, var(--dsw-font-family)` 优先栈（如工作区浏览器），装了 Inter 的系统上这些位置仍显示 Inter
- 与 dsh-fonts 同时安装时：任一组选中预设/自定义即以本组为准（本插件样式表排在其后）；只想要其一可 `dsh plugin --profile <name> remove <另一插件>`

- **[zhijun-dai/dsh-Fonts](https://github.com/zhijun-dai/dsh-Fonts)** — **本项目的直接参考与灵感来源**：bundle patch 层的组织方式（`cordis.patch.yml` 单条 insert）、`dsh.client` 双面声明、设置行槽位集成、localStorage 持久化与“预设 + 自定义导入”的产品形态均借鉴自该仓库。dsh-Fonts 证明了 DSH 上可以做字体系统，本插件站在它的肩膀上，补充了界面/代码分组独立选择与本地字体库免转换能力。感谢作者 [@zhijun-dai](https://github.com/zhijun-dai)
- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — 插件化架构与 `dsh.client` 双面插件机制
- [Fontsource](https://fontsource.org) — 在线预设的 webfont 分发
- 上游字体：[Inter](https://github.com/rsms/inter)、[JetBrains Mono](https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono)、[IBM Plex](https://github.com/IBM/plex)、[Fira Code](https://github.com/tonsky/FiraCode)、[Noto Sans SC](https://fonts.google.com/noto/specimen/Noto+Sans+SC) — 均 OFL/SIL 授权

**Typography plugin for DeepSeek Harness** — independent interface & code fonts · online presets · zero-conversion local font library [](https://github.com/Gan332/dsh-typography/stargazers) [](https://github.com/Gan332/dsh-typography/issues) [](./LICENSE) 中文 | [English](./README.md)

The DeepSeek Harness Web UI exposes two font entry points as CSS variables: `--dsw-font-family` (interface) and `--ds-font-family-code` (code), consumed by every component through `var()`. dsh-typography turns them into two **fully independent** selections:

- **Separate interface / code fonts**: each group has its own preset cards, import editor, and persisted state
- **Online presets**: Inter + JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Sans + Fira Code, Noto Sans SC (full Simplified Chinese coverage); font files ship via the jsDelivr CDN and fall back to system stacks offline
- **Local font library**: drop any `woff2/ttf/otf` into `%DSH_HOME%\typography\`, refresh, apply with one click — **TTF works directly, no woff2 conversion needed**
- **Variable-font friendly**: pick "variable · all weights" to emit a `font-weight: 100 900` descriptor with real weight rendering
- **Hands-off defaults**: a group set to "Default" writes no styles at all, coexisting with other font plugins
- **Cross-DSH-version compatibility**: adapted for DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 — the `defineStore` engine lives in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`, but that package carries no `dsh.client` declaration and never becomes a row in the client module table, so the plugin bundles its own minimal snapshot store engine (action signature matches the official contract: `(draft, ...args) => void`); `dsh.client.inject` only declares the core services present in every supported DSH version (slots / loc

This is a dual-face plugin: the host half serves local font files while the browser half provides the registry and settings row. After install it appears under **Settings → General → Fonts (interface / code)**.

**Install:**

DeepSeek Harness has two entry points with independent profiles — install into whichever you use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Gan332/dsh-typography
dsh plugin --profile web add -w /path/to/dsh-typography

readme.section: local directory (the profile dir is a pnpm workspace root; -w is required)
readme.text:
```

Then restart the matching entry. Desktop note: a terminal install records a recovery transaction that the app **verifies and clears on its next start**; when installing several plugins in a row, restart between installs.

**Switching fonts:** click a card in either group to apply live; "Default" restores the system stack.powershell
copy C:\Users\fish\Downloads\MiSansVF.ttf $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\typography\
```

readme.section: local directory (the profile dir is a pnpm workspace root; -w is required)
readme.text:
Refresh → your group → Local font library → click `MiSansVF`. Zero conversion, all variable weights.

**Font URL formats** — same-origin relative paths are recommended (port-independent):
/plugins/dsh-typography/files/MiSansVF.ttf          ✅ recommended (same-origin)
http://127.0.0.1:43120/plugins/dsh-typography/...   ⚠️ works, but breaks if the port shifts
https://cdn.example.com/some-font.woff2             ✅ external CDN direct link
```

The browser half provides the registry on the root context; other plugins can consume it via `ctx.get("typography")`:

```ts
const typography = ctx.get("typography")
// two independent groups: "ui" | "code"
typography?.select("code", "inter-jetbrains")
typography?.setCustom("ui", [

Full types live in `lib/types/client/index.d.ts`.

- On `apply` the browser half publishes the registry via `ctx.provide("typography", registry)`; selection changes rewrite the injected `<style id="dsh-typography-style">` sheet: `@font-face` rules plus CSS-variable overrides for non-default groups only
- The host half registers `/plugins/dsh-typography/files/*` through `ctx.webServer`, serving files from `%DSH_HOME%\typography` (`font/woff2 | font/ttf | font/otf` by extension; `?list=1` returns the index JSON)
- Selections persist in browser `localStorage` (`dsh-typography:prefs`) and are restored on boot; stale preset ids are ignored during restore
- The settings row registers into the Settings → General item slot (`ctx.slots`, id `typography`) with bilingual copy from `ctx.locale`

- Online presets need internet; offline they fall back along the stack tail to system fonts
- Library file names must start with a letter/digit (Unicode letters fine; Chinese names work)
- A few components hardcode an `Inter, var(--dsw-font-family)` head (e.g. the workspace browser) and still show Inter where it is installed
- When installed alongside dsh-fonts: any non-default selection here wins for its variables (our sheet mounts later); to keep only one, `dsh plugin --profile <name> remove <the-other>`

- **[zhijun-dai/dsh-Fonts](https://github.com/zhijun-dai/dsh-Fonts)** — **the direct reference and inspiration for this project**: the bundle-patch layout (single `cordis.patch.yml` insert), the `dsh.client` dual-face declaration, settings-slot integration, localStorage persistence, and the "presets + custom import" product shape all follow that repository. dsh-Fonts proved a font system was possible on DSH; this plugin stands on its shoulders and adds independent interface/code groups plus a zero-conversion local library. Thanks to [@zhijun-dai](https://github.com/zhijun-dai)
- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — the plugin architecture and the `dsh.client` dual-face mechanism
- [Fontsource](https://fontsource.org) — webfont distribution for the online presets
